notes: Four pipeline stages are authored, each re-run by the verifier on fresh hidden inputs, so hidden_case_generalization=3. reasoning_depth=2: the reshard stage must honour two adversarial caps (per-directory item count and a per-file byte budget that forces splitting oversized members into a re-assemblable chunk scheme) and the fixed-width parser must place exact byte offsets for numeric fields right-aligned zero-padded and keep adjacent records aligned (an off-by-one offset corrupts every record after the first). dependent_stages=2: the fixture output_tree is produced by running reshard and must itself satisfy the same cap+preservation rules the hidden re-runs are graded on, and manifest.json is the concrete output of order_and_hash's manifest mode over the shipped seed tree. adversarial_inputs=2: hidden cases probe text/binary discrimination (binary containers that themselves contain CR/LF bytes), oversized files forcing chunking, exact-boundary and empty files, a trailing not-multiple-of-width record block, and an unknown record type. quantitative_correctness=2: byte-for-byte reproducibility of the archive and exact sha256/size equality in the manifest are measured exactly. The four stages are pure file/byte data_processing (tool_breadth=1), hold no cross-stage long-lived state, and carry no unsafe-action penalty.
